# laravelforge_site_composer_credential (Resource)

Manages a Composer authentication credential for a repository host on a Laravel Forge site.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `organization` (String) Organization slug.
- `password` (String, Sensitive) Password (or token) for the Composer credential.
- `repository` (String) Repository host the credential authenticates against (the credential's identity).
- `server_id` (Number) Numeric ID of the server the site belongs to.
- `site_id` (Number) Numeric ID of the site the credential belongs to.
- `username` (String) Username for the Composer credential.
